scientific_integrity: Analytical proof supplies infinite-scale conclusion; exact numerical checks are illustrative and finite.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a fixed-section logarithmic asymptotic of one saddle stable branch for b>0 and a>2sqrt(b); no uniform moving-section control, multiplicative prefactor or other-model universality is asserted. Priority remains provisional relative to broad singular perturbation principles; independent validation absent.
title: Exact singular-funnel action for an adaptive pitchfork
